title: Vogue The World Of Ginny Doll Communion 8" VTG 1984 Poseable All Vinyl NIB
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The Vogue The World Of Ginny Doll Communion 8" VTG 1984 Poseable All Vinyl NIB is an 8-inch vintage doll from 1984 by the Vogue Doll Company. This original girl doll has straight brown hair, green eyes, and a light complexion. Made of vinyl and packaged in its original unopened box, this collectible piece is a single unit perfect for all occasions. The doll, part of the Ginny product line, is a classic addition to any doll collection, showcasing the craftsmanship and style of the 1980s.
